quantities.label: Peak ground acceleration
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Peak ground velocity
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Spectral acceleration, T = 0.3 s, 5% damping
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Spectral acceleration, T = 1.0 s, 5% damping
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Spectral acceleration, T = 3.0 s, 5% damping
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Observed spectral acceleration, T = 1.0 s, 5% damping
quantities.description: A measurement of SA(1.0) at one bridge, with error. Observing it conditions the bridge's SA(1.0) softly, where observing SA(1.0) itself would fix it.

quantities.label: Permanent ground displacement: liquefaction
quantities.description: Permanent ground displacement from lateral spread or settlement: 0 where the stretch does not liquefy, so liquefaction occurs exactly when it is positive.

quantities.label: Permanent ground displacement: landslide
quantities.description: Permanent ground displacement from Newmark sliding of the slope: 0 where the slope holds or does not slide, so the ground moved exactly when it is positive.

quantities.label: Permanent ground displacement: fault crossing
quantities.description: Permanent ground displacement from the fault's offset: 0 without surface rupture, so the fault ruptured at the crossing exactly when it is positive.

quantities.label: Road open at a liquefaction component
quantities.description: Whether the road stays usable where the ground moved (liquefaction): False closed, True open. The edge is open only if every such component on it is.

quantities.label: Road open at a landslide component
quantities.description: Whether the road stays usable where the ground moved (landslide): False closed, True open. The edge is open only if every such component on it is.

quantities.label: Road open at a fault crossing component
quantities.description: Whether the road stays usable where the ground moved (fault crossing): False closed, True open. The edge is open only if every such component on it is.

quantities.label: Edge open to traffic
quantities.description: False closed, True open (state indices 0 and 1). The edge state the system functions read.

quantities.label: System event survives
quantities.description: Fail or Survival (state indices 0 and 1), by the event's own definition: a travel time within its tolerance of the intact network's, or a max flow at or above its threshold. The binary node a system-reliability analysis is about.
